newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Neste 1996 profit seen lower.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Neste 1996 profit seen lower.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 410 million markka median forecast for Finnish oil and energy group Neste Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 15 analysts, EPS by 13 analysts). @
Neste's results are due on February 28 at around 1100/0900 GMT.
In 1995, Neste had a 1.36 billion markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Ten analysts also gave forecasts for Neste's dividend for 1996 with the median at 2.40 markka (mean 2.00 markka) in a 0.40-2.80 markka range. The 1995 dividend was 2.40 markka.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, 10 of the 15 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 1.31 billion markka (mean 1.32 billion) in a 975 million to 1.73 billion markka range. @

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Den Danske Bank, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
